Semantic summary: a battle-presentation sub-effect that pans BG2's X reference point halfway between the effect state's first and last party member, seeds a small per-row 'vine' ring and a much larger 21-item-per-row burst table sized by a per-variant row count (Data_080eecfc[state->0x18]), then runs one pass per animation frame. Each row activates once the running frame counter crosses its own Data_080eecf7[row]+0x12 threshold: from then on every pass draws and steps all 21 of that row's burst items (position/speed/shape driven by Func_08004458 and the Data_080eecff/080eed0e/080eed1e width/height/sprite-offset tables); before that threshold every pass instead draws and grows the row's own vine entry once the row's plain Data_080eecf7[row] threshold is passed. Exactly on the frame a row's activation threshold is first crossed, the owner also cues Func_080d6888 for every real party member on the state.

Every field access width and signedness (u8 vs s8, u16, s16, s32) was verified against the individual ldr/ldrb/ldrsb/ldrh/ldrsh/str/strh mnemonics in games/gs1/asm/080e2538.s rather than trusted from the m2c placeholder types, since m2c's default type inference does not reliably distinguish signed byte loads from unsigned ones.

Data_080eecb2/080eecf2/080eecf7/080eecfc/080eecff/080eed0e/080eed1e are small tables placed near this owner's own object code (~0x080eecb2-0x080eed2e); named by address only, per the established Data_<addr> convention (e.g. games/gs1/recon/en/main/080e01e4.c's Data_080ede48), since no cross-owner evidence yet ties them to a more specific shared vocabulary.
No GS2 or external source was used; no other Golden Sun decompilation project was consulted.
